name: Area MACD
summary: Area MACD is a custom MACD indicator for MetaTrader 5 that fills the area between the MACD line and signal line with different colors to visually highlight bullish and bearish momentum. It does not open trades and serves purely as a visual analysis tool for traders to identify momentum shifts.
summary_zh: Area MACD是一个MetaTrader 5自定义MACD指标，通过在MACD线和信号线之间填充不同颜色来直观显示看涨和看跌动量。它不会开仓交易，纯粹作为视觉分析工具帮助交易者识别动量转换。
strategy_analysis: Area MACD是一个技术指标而非交易EA，不具备自主开仓或平仓功能。其核心概念基于经典MACD（移动平均收敛散度）指标，通过计算快速EMA与慢速EMA的差值生成MACD线，再对MACD线取信号线均值。该指标的创新之处在于用颜色填充MACD线与信号线之间的区域：当MACD线高于信号线时填充绿色表示看涨动量，当MACD线低于信号线时填充红色表示看跌动量。这种可视化方式比传统MACD柱状图更直观，帮助交易者快速判断动量方向和强度。该指标不包含任何仓位管理、资金管理或风控逻辑，仅提供视觉信号辅助手动交易决策。
strategy_analysis_en: Area MACD is a technical indicator rather than a trading EA, and it does not possess autonomous position opening or closing capabilities. Its core concept is based on the classic MACD (Moving Average Convergence Divergence) indicator, calculating the difference between a fast EMA and a slow EMA to generate the MACD line, then applying a signal line as an EMA of the MACD line. The innovation of this indicator lies in filling the area between the MACD line and signal line with color: green fill when MACD is above signal indicating bullish momentum, and red fill when MACD is below signal indicating bearish momentum. This visualization approach is more intuitive than the traditional MACD histogram, helping traders quickly assess momentum direction and strength. The indicator contains no position sizing, money management, or risk control logic, serving solely as a visual aid for manual trading decisions.
pros: 颜色填充区域比传统柱状图更直观地展示动量方向和强度
基于经典MACD指标，理论基础扎实，交易者熟悉度高
视觉化设计减少了误读信号的可能性，提升分析效率
参数可调，适应不同交易风格和时间周期
pros_en: Color-filled area provides more intuitive visualization of momentum direction and strength than traditional histogram
Based on the classic MACD indicator with solid theoretical foundation and high trader familiarity
Visual design reduces the likelihood of misreading signals and improves analysis efficiency
Adjustable parameters accommodate different trading styles and timeframes
cons: 作为纯指标工具，不提供自动交易功能，需要交易者自行决策
缺少报警或通知功能，无法在关键动量转换时主动提醒
MACD指标本身存在滞后性，在快速市场中信号可能延迟
未提供超买超卖区域标识，交易者需自行判断极端动量
cons_en: As a pure indicator tool, it does not provide automated trading functionality, requiring traders to make their own decisions
Lacks alert or notification features, cannot proactively notify on key momentum shifts
MACD inherently has lagging characteristics, signals may be delayed in fast-moving markets
No overbought/oversold zone identification, traders must judge extreme momentum independently
improvements: 增加报警功能，在MACD与信号线交叉时推送通知
添加零线参考和动量极值标识，辅助判断超买超卖区域
improvements_en: Add alert functionality to push notifications when MACD and signal line cross
Add zero-line reference and momentum extremum markers to help identify overbought/oversold zones

risk_points: 纯指标工具，不执行交易操作，无直接资金风险
依赖交易者对MACD信号的正确解读，存在人为判断风险
risk_points_en: Pure indicator tool with no trading operations, no direct financial risk
Relies on trader's correct interpretation of MACD signals, introducing human judgment risk

summary_en: Area MACD is a custom MACD indicator for MetaTrader 5 that fills the area between the MACD line and signal line with different colors to visually highlight bullish and bearish momentum. It does not open trades and serves purely as a visual analysis tool for traders to identify momentum shifts.
